verdict.rationale: Turso explicitly documents provisioning thousands/millions of isolated databases programmatically via API for per-user/per-agent use cases, which directly supports bulk automation for AI-native workflows (turso-docs-8, turso-docs-12, turso-docs-13). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of large-scale bulk provisioning, and explicit documentation of bulk row-level SQL batch operations (e.g. batch insert/update APIs) beyond database-level scale.
